optimus_princeps.name: Optimus Princeps
optimus_princeps.description: Tries to include as much territory as possible in their empire. Does not like civilizations who control little territory.

queen_of_the_nile.name: Queen of the Nile
queen_of_the_nile.description: Likes civilizations with powerful armies. Dislikes civilizations with weak ones.

delian_league.name: Delian League
delian_league.description: Likes civilizations that aren't competing for the same city-state allegiance. Dislikes civilizations that are directly competing for city-state allegiance.

wonder_obsessed.name: Wonder Obsessed
wonder_obsessed.description: Likes civilizations not competing for wonders, and builds wonders whenever possible. Dislikes losing a wonder to another civilization.

ally_of_enkidu.name: Ally of Enkidu
ally_of_enkidu.description: Likes civilizations who are willing to form a long-term alliance. Dislikes anyone denouncing or attacking his friends and allies.

tlatoani.name: Tlatoani
tlatoani.description: Likes civilizations who have the same Luxury resources as he does, and will try to collect every Luxury resource available. Dislikes civilizations who have a new Luxury resource he has not yet collected.

city_planner.name: City Planner
city_planner.description: Always tries to keep the maximum number of districts in each city. Respects other civilizations who also develop their cities in this fashion.

backstab_averse.name: Backstab Averse
backstab_averse.description: Likes civilizations who are their declared friend. Hates civilizations who backstab and declare surprise wars.

sun_never_sets.name: The Sun Never Sets
sun_never_sets.description: Likes civilizations whose empire spans the world. Dislikes civilizations content with a handful of cities.

iron_crown.name: Iron Crown
iron_crown.description: Dislikes civilizations who court the city-states he means to bring under the crown himself.

westernizer.name: Westernizer
westernizer.description: Admires civilizations who build out their cities in every direction, and learns from them. Dislikes civilizations who leave their cities undeveloped.

cheomseongdae.name: Cheomseongdae
cheomseongdae.description: Likes civilizations who fill their cities with districts of learning. Dislikes civilizations who neglect them.

solitary_observer.name: Solitary Observer
solitary_observer.description: Keeps her own cities close together, and thinks well of civilizations who do not sprawl. Dislikes civilizations who claim half the world.

trade_caravans.name: Trade Caravans
trade_caravans.description: Likes civilizations who keep their word, because a caravan route is only worth what the promise behind it is. Dislikes civilizations who break their agreements.

sea_lanes.name: Sea Lanes
sea_lanes.description: Likes civilizations who stand by their allies across the water. Dislikes civilizations who abandon a friend.

trial_by_combat.name: Trial by Combat
trial_by_combat.description: Likes civilizations with an army worth measuring himself against. Dislikes civilizations too weak to be worth the trouble.

ingoma_yenkosi.name: Ingoma Yenkosi
ingoma_yenkosi.description: Likes civilizations who muster a real army. Holds civilizations with no army in contempt.

king_of_the_eburones.name: King of the Eburones
king_of_the_eburones.description: Likes civilizations strong enough to be worth fighting. Dislikes civilizations who leave themselves undefended.

enthusiastic_disciple.name: Enthusiastic Disciple
enthusiastic_disciple.description: Likes civilizations who share the luxuries of his own court. Dislikes civilizations hoarding a luxury he has never seen.

garden_of_the_east.name: Garden of the East
garden_of_the_east.description: Likes civilizations who honour their agreements. Dislikes civilizations who arrive uninvited and at war.

patron_of_the_arts.name: Patron of the Arts
patron_of_the_arts.description: Likes civilizations who build wonders for the world to admire. Dislikes civilizations who build none.
